thread:
olivia_csm: FYI — we're seeing an auth regression blocking VPC onboarding for tenants created in the last 48h. Drafting customer comms and need approval for a one-week goodwill credit for affected trials. Can eng/ops confirm root cause and ETA? Incident INC-2025-872. @jamal_support @steve_eng @sam_ops
incident-bot: INC-2025-872 | created | severity: high | impacted: ~37 new VPC trial tenants | status: investigating
jamal_support: Repro steps and cause: refresh endpoint returns 401 when refresh_window == 0 due to a boundary check introduced in last deploy. Repro: create tenant -> trigger refresh -> curl POST /v1/auth/refresh -> 401. Log sample: `auth.refresh tenant=tn-77 status=401 window=0`
steve_eng: Acknowledged. Hotfix: revert the offending check + add tests. Plan: canary in us-west-2 at ~08:40 UTC, monitor 15m, full rollout target ~09:20 UTC. Will publish statuspage note after canary is green.
sam_ops: We can also temporarily relax refresh enforcement per-tenant via an internal flag to reduce customer impact while fix deploys. I can flip it for the cohort if CS supplies the tenant IDs to prioritize.
liam_csm: Query shows 9 tenants have <30d left on trial; 4 of those are marked high-touch/renewal-risk. Recommend prioritized outreach to the 9 and dedicated handoff for the 4.
maria_finance: Finance ACK: one-week platform credit for affected trials is approved. Please tag credits with incident code for tracking.
olivia_csm: Thanks all. Draft short trial note (concise): "Hello — we’re investigating an authentication issue affecting onboarding for a subset of new VPC tenants. Engineers are deploying a fix and we expect full onboarding to be restored within ~60 minutes. For affected trials we will apply a one-week credit and offer a 1:1 enablement session to complete setup. Sorry for the interruption — Olivia, Redwood CSM."

olivia_csm: Draft exec note for at-risk accounts: "Hello — we’re contacting you proactively. Some trial tenants in VPC onboarding experienced intermittent authentication failures. We’ve deployed mitigation and expect full service shortly. To mitigate impact we will: (1) grant a one-week usage credit, (2) schedule a 30-min enablement call within 3 business days, and (3) assign a CS lead to coordinate. We'll follow up with an RCA and a short impact survey. Reply with available times for a call. — Olivia"
jamal_support: Quick workaround to share with customers who can run it: re-run onboarding job or rotate the onboarding token via Console. Example sanitized retry curl: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/onboard/retry -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"tenant_id":"tn-77"}'`
steve_eng: Will publish a short RCA link and status update after rollout. Target public update by ~09:30 UTC. Once Ops confirms the relax flag is set for the cohort, CS can send the trial blast and exec notes for the prioritized list.
olivia_csm: Next steps: Sam to confirm flag flip or Canary success, Steve to confirm rollback health, Maria already approved credits. I'll queue outreach templates and DM the 9 tenant IDs to Sam for prioritization. Posting here after messages go out. Thanks everyone.
